verdicts.reason: A sets the headline on one line at a size that fills the strip and reads clearly, which suits a banner. Its flaws: the left margin is a little narrower than the right, so the line looks slightly off-centre, and there is very little space above and below the text. B keeps the original's centred, minimal feel, but shrinks the headline to a tiny size in a sea of empty space, so it is barely readable at the target size and has none of the original's bold presence.
